part: Mélanges de Colbert 26, part I: diplomatic correspondence of Gaspard Coignet de La Thuillerie (French ambassador, mission to Denmark/Sweden 1644-1646) and Abel Servien (French plenipotentiary at the Westphalia congress, Munster/Deventer), 1644-1648
finding_aid: archivesetmanuscrits.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/cc955062 (FRBNFEAD000095506) -- lists 15 original La Thuillerie letters at fol. 1, 24, 27, 31, 35, 43, 50, 58 (La Haye, 1644-1648), fol. 11 (Hambourg, 1644), fol. 13 (Heiderslebe, 1644), fol. 15, 19, 21 (Coppenhaghen, 1644-1646), fol. 17 (Christianopoli, 1645), with Servien's response minutes at fol. 3 (Deventer), fol. 5, 8 (Munster); no mention of 'chiffre'/'dechiffre' anywhere in the finding-aid text
folio_to_canvas: folio = canvas - 3 (confirmed: canvas 19 labelled '16' top-right and closes the Coppenhaghen 19 Nov 1644 letter fol.15-16; canvas 20 labelled top-right consistent with fol.17 = Christianopoli 1645 per the finding aid)
canvases_fetched: 1-72 except 11 (two fetch attempts both failed: HTTP 500, then a connection reset -- not retried further per the good-citizen one-retry rule)
canvases_total_part1_estimate: part I is stated as 66 feuillets; canvas ~4-69 by the KX-COLB26 boundary probe, confirmed here canvas 70+ already shows different (Part II, Brienne 1661) content
cipher_found: canvas 20-21 (folio 17-18): one letter, La Thuillerie to Servien, dated 'A Christianopoli le 6 Avril 1645' (signature block, canvas 21), numeral-nomenclator cipher run inline with clear French, WITH a contemporary interlinear decipherment gloss (small hand, different from the main secretary hand) written above/below specific numeral groups on both leaves -- e.g. 'Je parle des Suedois' over '6 25 zz 11 83 v 44 w' 85', 'pour les Dannois qui' over 'Car 63 68', 'leur plaic[e]... ilz sont f[or]t abatuz' around '42 ilz estoient en 56 99'. This is a key-beside-the-letter case (a period decipherment written on the document itself), not yet transcribed as a key.
